subject: ACME pipeline cleanroom — 48h commit sprint (amounts, SKUs, next steps)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME pipeline cleanroom — 48h commit sprint (amounts, SKUs, next steps)

Team —

Quick heads-up: Acme's renewal/expansion is sitting in commit for $3.2M but the CRM record is noisy (multiple SKUs, duplicate line items, and probability drift). Finance is asking for a sanitized commit by COB Friday so it lands in the board forecast for May close.

Proposal: a short 48-hour "cleanroom" where we lock three things: canonical amount, product/SKU mapping, and a single Next Step + updated probability.

Asks:
- Ben: own product/SKU mapping and dedupe line items; produce a single mapping CSV.
- Lauren: validate ARR values and probability with Finance; confirm the final close date.
- Marissa: take point on AE comms and get Sam to confirm the mutual action plan and any procurement timing.

Attached: the raw CRM export I pulled (acme-oppty-export.csv) and a draft MAP (acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx). I'll drop a HubSpot snapshot to the Drive.

Deadline: please update the CRM record and push your cleaned artifact to the Drive folder by EOD Friday (2028-05-10 17:00 PT). If any blocker, call it out in thread and escalate to me.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME pipeline cleanroom — 48h commit sprint (amounts, SKUs, next steps)

Thanks Jordan — I can take SKU mapping. Early scan notes:
- Two line items labelled "Premium Inference" look like duplicates but have different unit counts.
- There's an old addon SKU (INF-EVAL-01) that Acme says they're not purchasing anymore.

Plan: I will produce acme-sku-mapping.csv with:
  * canonical SKU per line item
  * normalization of unit counts
  * flag for deprecated SKUs to remove from ARR calculation

I'll start with the CRM export you attached and sync with the product team if I hit ambiguous mappings. Expect first draft by EOD Thur (2028-05-09).

Ben

Subject: Re: ACME pipeline cleanroom — 48h commit sprint (amounts, SKUs, next steps)

Looping Finance and AE next steps: I spoke with finance (cc'd internally) — they need the canonical ARR amount and a single probability value. I'll validate the math on the export and re-run our ARR calc after Ben's SKU mapping lands.

Marissa: can you get Sam to confirm the final MOP and procurement timing? If procurement wants a PO date, we need that to peg probability to 70/90/100.

I attached the oppty export I pulled with my annotations (acme-oppty-export.csv). I highlighted three line items where amounts look overstated versus the proposed pricing in the MAP.

I will update the CRM record with the revised ARR and probability once Ben's mapping is ready; target to update CRM by EOD Fri.

Lauren

Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME pipeline cleanroom — 48h commit sprint (amounts, SKUs, next steps)

Hi team — quick update from AE side after a short call with Sam.

- Sam confirmed they will not purchase the legacy INF-EVAL-01 SKU (Ben flagged that).
- Their procurement team expects to issue a PO in the week of 2028-05-20, so the close date should be pushed out to 2028-05-24 for forecasting accuracy.
- Sam attached the signed MAP and asked us to reflect the committed SKU set in the CRM.

Sam (cc'd) — can you confirm the PO week above and whether the unit counts Ben proposes match what Acme expects?

Attaching: acme-oppty-export.csv (annotated), acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (signed stub).

Marissa
